# document-slice-consistency

Units-generation exit and construction admission/report recheck. Canonical
requirements.md and user-stories.md remain complete. Recompute lossless source
ranges, approved story-to-unit map, REQ/Story/AC denominators, AC owners and unit
req_refs reconciliation; compare expected manifest and actual object bytes.
Evidence binds current canonical, mapping, units, adoption, manifest and objects.
Identity, stale projections, omissions, ambiguous/dangling ownership, modified
bodies and unsafe paths fail closed. No author assertion is accepted.

New full workflows with ≥2 units require slices after unit generation; old
unadopted workflows, single units and skipped unit generation retain explicit
compatibility. Existing adoption/manifest can never exempt itself by corruption
or count/scope changes. See knowledge/protocols/common-document-slices.md.
